hero.subtitle: Historic 18th-century Gustavian manor house. Available exclusively as a whole — for up to 21 guests.

intro.titleA: A house that has welcomed guests for
intro.p1: Andreashof was built in 1782 as the manor of a Pomeranian landed family. The symmetrical façade, the high half-timbered gable and the restrained proportions still speak of the Gustavian taste of that era — a Scandinavian elegance that carries to this day.
intro.p2: Behind the tall windows: light-filled rooms, white-washed floorboards, linen and stone. Space for 21 guests, and yet a stillness that does not end when the last car arrives.

family.title: Family gatherings
family.body: Generous common rooms and ten bedrooms — space for three generations under one roof.

weddings.title: Weddings
weddings.body: A symmetrical façade, a garden with a lime-tree avenue and a long table for 21. A day that stays.

retreats.title: Retreats & workshops
retreats.body: Stillness, wide fields, high-ceilinged rooms. A place for teams, writing retreats and quiet days.

gallery.title: Light, line, linen.
gallery.subtitle: Impressions from the salon, dining room, bedchambers and garden — photographed in the soft light of a Pomeranian summer.

roomsTeaser.body: Each room carries a name, each has its own view. High ceilings, white-painted floorboards, linen curtains.

zimmer.pageSubtitle: Choose a chamber to see bed, view and atmosphere.

I.name: Linden Room
I.desc: Overlooking the old lime-tree avenue. High ceilings, white floorboards, a desk by the window.

II.name: Garden Suite
II.desc: Quietly facing the garden. Morning sun, lavender scent at dusk.

III.name: Gable Room
III.desc: Set high in the gable with exposed half-timbering. The stillness of the inner court.

IV.name: Salon Room
IV.desc: Generous, with stucco ceiling and parquet. Next door to the salon.

V.name: Chamber Hesse
V.desc: Simple, bright, rural. View across the fields to the horizon.

VI.name: Chamber Storch
VI.desc: Tucked at the rear, sheltered. Stork's nest on the chimney.

VII.name: North Mansard
VII.desc: Under the roof, ideal for siblings or friends travelling together.

VIII.name: South Mansard
VIII.desc: A small chamber under the southern roof. Sun all day.

IX.name: Library Room
IX.desc: Built-in shelves, reading chair, private door to the library.

X.name: Servants' Chamber
X.desc: In the former servants' wing. Own entrance, snug.

items.q: We were 19 people across four generations — no one had to crowd in. The house breathes stillness.
Our wedding in the garden under the limes. The light in the salon at evening was beyond words.
Three days of strategy retreat. Quiet, wide fields, excellent food. We will be back.

booking.body: Tell us about your occasion, your wishes and the dates you have in mind. We respond within 24 hours.
booking.thanks: Thank you — we'll be in touch shortly.

items.q: Can you rent part of the house, or only the whole?
items.a: Andreashof is rented exclusively as a whole, to preserve the atmosphere for your group.
Yes. We regularly host weddings, family gatherings and private celebrations. We're glad to recommend caterers and local services.
Free parking for up to twelve vehicles in the inner courtyard.
Well-mannered dogs are welcome on request. Please let us know when you inquire.
Free cancellation up to 60 days before arrival. Details in our terms.
Personal welcome on arrival day from 4 pm. Key handover and a short tour included.

footer.tagline: A historic 18th-century manor house in Western Pomerania — for families, weddings and retreats.
